label: prose:intro-hecke-baer-star-chirality
html: The Kazhdan–Lusztig bar involution q \mapsto q^{-1} on H_n(q) induces a Baer-* involution on the centralizer algebra that pairs each Young partition \lambda with its transpose \lambda' while fixing self-conjugate diagrams \lambda = \lambda'. This section establishes the generic Baer-* structure, formulates the Murphy–Lagrange central idempotents in terms of Jucys–Murphy content interpolation, and shows how the chirality period pairing separates chiral knot classes from their mirror images on Bring's surface.
